name: 3-(trimethoxysilylpropyl)diethylenetriamine
description: 3-(Trimethoxysilylpropyl)diethylenetriamine (CAS 35141-30-1 ), commercially available as Dynasylan TRIAMO, is an aminosilane coupling agent that bridges inorganic substrates and organic polymer matrices. Its multiple amine groups enable both surface bonding and cross-linking functions within a single molecule, making it a preferred choice where standard monoamine silanes fall short. In adhesives, sealants, and epoxy systems, it improves adhesion to glass, metals, and mineral fillers by chemically linking the substrate to the polymer network. Electronics manufacturers use it as a surface primer on circuit board laminates and encapsulant interfaces to improve moisture resistance and bond durability. In coatings for automotive and aerospace components, it acts as an adhesion promoter on metal and composite surfaces, reducing delamination under thermal cycling. Plastics compounders incorporate it as a coupling agent for glass fiber-reinforced systems, improving mechanical strength retention in demanding structural applications. Supplied as a liquid, typically in neat form. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity levels commonly specified at 95% or higher. Packaging ranges from small laboratory quantities to drum and IBC supply for industrial-scale use, ensuring reliable delivery for diverse manufacturing requirements.
